product: Filter data per end user with OAuth custom identity claims
tagline: You can now add a custom identity claim to a service principal's OAuth token and filter rows by it in a dynamic view or ABAC policy.
what_it_does: You can now add a custom identity claim to a service principal's OAuth token and filter rows by it in a dynamic view or ABAC policy. Serve many end users through one service principal while each sees only their own data. This page explains how to serve many end users through a single service principal while each user sees only their own data.
why_it_matters: Reduces operational overhead and unlocks new capabilities for data teams on Databricks.
plain_summary: You can now add a custom identity claim to a service principal's OAuth token and filter rows by it in a dynamic view or ABAC policy. Serve many end users through one service principal while each sees only their own data.
key_takeaway: You can now add a custom identity claim to a service principal's OAuth token and filter rows by it in a dynamic view or ABAC policy.
